subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but overlapping sibling PRs and the new interpretation of plugin-authored availability-like records require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after refresh because it covers planner callback, plugin registration wiring, malformed metadata guards, and regression coverage without filtering returned tools.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Select another open PR if maintainers prefer a smaller planner-only or descriptor-registration-only implementation, then close this PR after that path lands.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if maintainers want malformed plugin availability to affect tool visibility rather than only warn, since that would be a stronger compatibility choice.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after refresh because it covers planner callback, plugin registration wiring, malformed metadata guards, and regression coverage without filtering returned tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on plugin descriptor-cache behavior and plugin metadata compatibility, where the history points most strongly.
